name: studybot
description: STUDYBOT — Smart Student Companion Mobile App

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true}); ['index.html','style.css','script.js','supabase.js','supabaseConfig.js','aptitudeData.js','aptitudeEngine.js'].forEach(f=>{ if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f,'www/'+f); }); console.log('Assets copied to www/');"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
